promotion_trigger: Promote when the prototype reader consumes the research fixture and emits a complete named-opcode coverage table.
expected_failing_assertion: The d3d11 research surface defers with no reader prototype.

procedure: Run the prototype reader over the DXBC and DXIL research fixture.
Emit the opcode coverage table with unsupported opcode named.

pass_criterion: Every opcode is covered or named unsupported.
